_doc: coldpath agent on the luceneutil host: one arm per storage. data_path holds luceneutil's indices/ directory (INDEX_DIR_BASE = <data_path>/indices), so /cache/residency?uuids=<index name> checks <data_path>/indices/<name>/index/ and /cache/drop pages out the SearchPerfTest JVM's mappings under it. No OpenSearch node: start/stop are no-ops and /node/restart is not used.
